traits.name: Thick Hide
traits.text:
The ogre has advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The ogre’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The ogre can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: light, mold earth, create bonfire * 1/day each: earth tremor, enhance ability, fog cloud, color spray
